component.name: Fable Flight
component.summary: Open-world flight simulator with real weather and live air traffic

description.p: This is a community package of Fable Flight, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Fable Flight is an open-world flight simulator written in Rust. Fly over the whole planet with real METAR weather, live ADS-B air traffic and a satellite or road minimap, alone or in multiplayer.

ul.li: Aircraft from a Cessna 172RG and Robin DR400 to a Boeing 747, F/A-18, F-22, Concorde and SR-71, plus downloadable FlightGear aircraft
Fuel, mass and balance, electrical failures, clickable cockpits, radio navigation and autopilot
Remappable keyboard, joystick, throttle and pedals
An optional arcade mode with boosts, missiles and in-flight respawns
An optional AI copilot over the Model Context Protocol

description.p: The package is sandboxed: it can reach the network, the GPU, sound, game controllers and its own data directory, and nothing else. Settings, key bindings, downloaded aircraft and caches live in ~/.var/app/io.github.Rolandjg.FableFlight.

The AI-copilot bridge is included. Point your MCP client at flatpak run --command=fableflight-mcp io.github.Rolandjg.FableFlight instead of the path to fableflight-mcp, for example claude mcp add fableflight -- flatpak run --command=fableflight-mcp io.github.Rolandjg.FableFlight.
